/**
 * 👍 / 👎 on an answer (plan F17, §2 Memory). Every rating reaches the H-MEM memories that shaped
 * the answer (their confidence goes up or down); a 👎 with a reason becomes a new correction the
 * Planner and Writer read next time a similar question comes up.
 */
export async function rateMessage(ownerId: string, messageId: string, input: Rating) {
  const message = await db.query.messages.findFirst({
    where: and(eq(messages.id, messageId), eq(messages.ownerId, ownerId)),
  })
  if (message?.role !== "assistant") throw new LibraryError("No such answer", 404)
  const run = message.runId
    ? await db.query.runs.findFirst({ where: eq(runs.id, message.runId) })
    : undefined
  const note =
    input.rating === "down" ? [input.reason, input.note?.trim()].filter(Boolean).join(": ") : null
  await db
    .update(messages)
    .set({ feedback: input.rating, feedbackNote: note || null })
    .where(eq(messages.id, messageId))
  if (!input.rating) return { remembered: false }

  const used = ((run?.receipt as { memories?: { id: string }[] } | null)?.memories ?? []).map(
    (m) => m.id,
  )
  rateRecalled(ownerId, used, input.rating === "up")
  if (input.rating === "down" && input.reason && run) {
    recordCorrection(ownerId, {
      question: run.question,
      reason: input.reason,
      note: input.note,
      chatId: message.chatId,
      messageId,
    })
    return { remembered: true }
  }
  return { remembered: false }
}

/** A 👎 with a reason: what the person said was wrong, kept with where it came from. */
export function recordCorrection(
  userId: string,
  input: { question: string; reason: string; note?: string; chatId: string; messageId: string },
): MemoryRecord {
  const note = input.note?.trim().replace(/[.\s]+$/, "")
  return memoryFor(userId).add({
    content: `About “${input.question}”: an earlier answer was marked “${input.reason}”${note ? `. The person said: ${note}` : ""}.`,
    type: "factual",
    layer: "working",
    tags: ["correction", input.reason.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-")],
    confidence: 0.8,
    source: `chat:${input.chatId}`,
    provenance: {
      origin: "user_correction",
      learnedAt: Date.now(),
      label: "Thumbs down on an answer",
      refs: [input.messageId],
    },
    chatId: input.chatId,
  })
}

async function recallFor(userId: string, question: string, topN = 3): Promise<Recalled[]> {
  const { memories } = memoryFor(userId).query(question, { topN: 8, threshold: 0.25 })
  if (!memories.length) return []
  const [q, ...vectors] = await embedQueries([question, ...memories.map((m) => m.memory.content)])
  return memories
    .map((m, i) => ({
      id: m.memory.id,
      content: m.memory.content,
      relevance: m.relevance,
      meaning: cosine(q as number[], vectors[i] as number[]),
    }))
    .filter((m) => m.meaning >= MIN_MEANING)
    .sort((a, b) => b.meaning - a.meaning)
    .slice(0, topN)
    .map(({ id, content, relevance }) => ({ id, content, relevance }))
}

/** Forget one memory (the Memory page). H-MEM keeps the deletion in its trust ledger. */
export function forget(userId: string, memoryId: string) {
  const memory = memoryFor(userId)
  if (!memory.store.get(memoryId)) return false
  memory.store.delete(memoryId, "Forgotten by the person")
  return true
}

async function recordInWorld(input: AnswerInput, question: string, matrix: Matrix, key: WorldKey) {
  const { tracer } = input
  const { world, namespace } = worldFor(key)
  const at = new Date()
  const by = (passageId?: string): Provenance => ({
    kind: "agent",
    by: "analyst",
    at,
    runId: tracer.runId,
    ...(passageId ? { url: `konkyo:passage:${passageId}` } : {}),
  })
  const context = await world.upsertContext({
    type: "run",
    externalKey: { system: "konkyo", id: tracer.runId },
    attrs: { question },
    source: by(),
  })
  const sourceIds = new Map<string, string>()
  for (const s of matrix.sources) {
    const entity = await world.upsertEntity({
      type: "source",
      externalKey: { system: "konkyo", id: s.fileId },
      name: s.title,
      attrs: { title: s.title, byline: s.byline },
      source: by(),
    })
    sourceIds.set(s.fileId, entity.id)
  }
  let relations = 0
  for (const claim of matrix.claims) {
    const entity = await world.upsertEntity({
      type: "claim",
      name: claim.text,
      attrs: { text: claim.text },
      source: by(),
    })
    claim.id = entity.id
    for (const cell of claim.cells) {
      await world.relate({
        from: sourceIds.get(cell.fileId) as string,
        type:
          cell.stance === "agrees"
            ? "supports"
            : cell.stance === "disagrees"
              ? "contradicts"
              : "qualifies",
        to: entity.id,
        context: context.id,
        attrs: { quote: cell.quote, passageId: cell.passageId, page: cell.page },
        source: by(cell.passageId),
      })
      relations++
    }

function worldFor(key: WorldKey) {
  const namespace = namespaceOf(key)
  const world = cachedWorld(
    namespace,
    worldFile(key),
    () => new WorldModel({ namespace, storage: "local", directory: WORLD_DIR }),

}

/**
 * Screens what was found against the question in Markovian RESEARCH steps (plan §2): each step
 * reads one batch of abstracts plus the shortlist so far (the carryover), never the whole pile,
 * so the context stays the same size however many sources come back. Returns at most 8 sources,
 * at most 2 of them web pages, best first, and Markovian's own estimate of the tokens saved.
 */
export async function screenSources(
  question: string,
  sources: FoundSource[],
  input: {
    tracer: Tracer
    onStep: (step: { step: number; of: number; kept: number }) => void
    abortSignal?: AbortSignal
  },
): Promise<{ shortlist: Shortlisted[]; report: ScreeningReport }> {
  const batches: FoundSource[][] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < sources.length; i += BATCH) batches.push(sources.slice(i, i + BATCH))
  const byKey = new Map(sources.map((s) => [s.key, s]))
  let shortlist: { key: string; score: number; why: string }[] = []
  const markovian = new Markovian({
    // One step reads a batch of 8 abstracts (~1,500 tokens) plus framing, the shortlist and its
    // output; Markovian requires chunkSize >= framing 400 + carryover + output budget 1,200.
    chunkConfig: {
      chunkSize: 3000,
      maxChunks: Math.min(32, Math.max(1, batches.length)),
      carryoverTokens: 512,
    },
  })

  const run = await markovian.run({
    mode: "RESEARCH",
    goal: `Find the sources that best answer: ${question}`,
    reflect: false,
    abortSignal: input.abortSignal,
    stepFn: async ({ step }) => {
      const batch = batches[step] ?? []
      const started = performance.now()
      const { result, choice } = await withFallback("screener", input.tracer, "screen", (c) =>
        generateText({
          model: model(c),
          providerOptions: reasoning(c),
          output: Output.object({ schema: Screened }),
          instructions:
            "You screen sources for a research question. Keep a source only if it would help answer the question (directly, or as needed background), judging from its title and abstract. Return the keys you keep with a score and a short reason. Keep the shortlist's earlier picks unless a new source is clearly better.",
          prompt: `Question: ${question}\n\nShortlist so far:\n${
            shortlist.length
              ? shortlist.map((k) => `[${k.key}] score ${k.score}: ${k.why}`).join("\n")
              : "(empty)"
          }\n\nNew sources:\n${batch.map(describeSource).join("\n\n")}`,
          abortSignal: input.abortSignal,
        }),
      )
      const merged = new Map(shortlist.map((k) => [k.key, k]))
      for (const k of result.output.keep) if (byKey.has(k.key)) merged.set(k.key, k)
      const ranked = [...merged.values()].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
      // At most two web pages: papers carry the evidence, pages the context.
      let web = 0
      shortlist = ranked
        .filter((k) => (byKey.get(k.key)?.kind === "web" ? ++web <= 2 : true))
        .slice(0, SHORTLIST)

/** 👍 / 👎 on an answer reaches the memories that shaped it (H-MEM feedback deltas). */
export function rateRecalled(userId: string, memoryIds: string[], helpful: boolean) {
  const memory = memoryFor(userId)
  // A memory forgotten since the answer was written has nothing left to rate.
  for (const id of memoryIds)
    if (memory.store.get(id)) memory.feedback(id, helpful ? "helpful" : "wrong")
}

/**
 * What a person's World Model holds (the knows page, plan F51): every claim two or more sources
 * take a position on, each source's stance with the quote it was read from, newest first. Read
 * from the rows the Analyst wrote, never a model. `fileIds` keeps only those sources (a space's).
 */
export function knowsOf(key: WorldKey, fileIds?: ReadonlySet<string>): KnownClaim[] {
  const { world } = worldFor(key)
  const shape = world.stateShape() as { entities: ShapeEntity[]; relationships: ShapeRelation[] }
  const entities = new Map(shape.entities.map((e) => [e.id, e]))
  const claims = new Map<string, KnownClaim>()
  for (const rel of shape.relationships) {
    const stance = STANCE_OF[rel.type]
    if (!stance || rel.validTo) continue
    const source = entities.get(rel.from)
    const claim = entities.get(rel.to)
    if (source?.type !== "source" || claim?.type !== "claim") continue
    const fileId = source.id.replace(/^source:konkyo:/, "")
    if (fileIds && !fileIds.has(fileId)) continue
    const known = claims.get(claim.id) ?? {
      id: claim.id,
      text: String(claim.attrs.text ?? claim.name ?? ""),
      at: claim.createdAt,
      cells: [],
    }
    if (rel.createdAt > known.at) known.at = rel.createdAt
    if (!known.cells.some((c) => c.fileId === fileId))
      known.cells.push({
        fileId,
        title: String(source.attrs.title ?? source.name ?? "A source"),
        stance,
        quote: String(rel.attrs?.quote ?? ""),
        passageId: String(rel.attrs?.passageId ?? ""),
        page: typeof rel.attrs?.page === "number" ? rel.attrs.page : null,
      })
    claims.set(claim.id, known)
  }
  return [...claims.values()]
    .filter((c) => c.cells.length >= 2 && c.text)
    .sort((a, b) => b.at.localeCompare(a.at))
}

export class HMEM {
  readonly ledger: TrustLedgerService;
  readonly store: MemoryStoreService;
  readonly mining: MemoryMiningService;
  readonly retrieval: MemoryRetrievalService;
  readonly conflicts: ConflictDetectionService;
  readonly sleep: SleepCycleService;
  readonly dreaming: DreamingService;
  readonly clock: () => number;

  constructor(opts: HMEMOptions = {}) {
    this.clock = opts.clock ?? Date.now;
    const actor = opts.actor ?? "system";
    this.ledger = new TrustLedgerService(this.clock, opts.persistDir);
    this.store = new MemoryStoreService(this.clock, this.ledger, actor, opts.persistDir);
    this.mining = new MemoryMiningService(this.store, this.clock, opts.minerFn);
    this.retrieval = new MemoryRetrievalService(this.store, this.ledger, this.clock, actor);
    this.conflicts = new ConflictDetectionService(this.store, this.ledger, this.clock, actor);
    this.sleep = new SleepCycleService(this.store, this.ledger, this.clock, actor);
    this.dreaming = new DreamingService(this.store, this.ledger, this.clock, actor);
  }

  // Convenience surface mirroring HOW_TO_USE_H-MEM.md.
  add(input: AddInput): MemoryRecord {
    return this.store.add(input);
  }
  mine(event: MiningEventType, text: string, opts?: { chatId?: string }): Promise<MemoryRecord[]> {
    return this.mining.mineInteraction(event, text, opts);
  }
  query(query: string, opts?: { topN?: number; threshold?: number; chatId?: string }): QueryResult {
    return this.retrieval.query(query, opts);
  }
  feedback(memoryId: string, kind: FeedbackKind): void {
    this.retrieval.feedback(memoryId, kind);
  }
}
